title: A CircleCI config is served (/.circleci/config.yml)
summary: The CI config is downloadable, which names the build steps, services and sometimes the paths and context the pipeline runs with.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("jobs:") and body_contains("version:") and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Keep CI config out of the web root.
